g.text: Input differences and outcome-gap changes answer different questions
Every assessable declared group/period is shown, including negative and near-zero changes; unsupported and aggregate-without-complement rows remain in
CSV. Each point pairs a descriptive input score with a separate held-out outcome audit. There is no fitted relationship, significance claim or causal
interpretation. Repeated groups/years are dependent. All two-feature × three-metric combinations are shown; no association was selected for
